tooltip.dreamsdimensions.oneiric_awakene: Hold to awaken and return to the Overworld (3 seconds).
message.dreamsdimensions.oneiric_awakene: You woke up from the dream.
A safe return was not possible. Your Awakener was preserved.
message.dreamsdimensions.echo_moss.found: The moss resonates. A nearby shimmer answers. Follow the trail.
message.dreamsdimensions.echo_moss.unava: The echo fades beyond the loaded area. Explore a little farther.
Allows sleep to open paths to other dimensions.
Entering without an Awakener may mean a long journey back.
message.dreamsdimensions.oneiric_awakene: You returned, but your inventory changed during the transition. The Awakener was not consumed; check the log.
message.dreamsdimensions.cracked_awakene: You woke through an unstable passage. Your Necklace will not respond for three nights.
Dream Hangover prevents your Necklace from responding tonight. Nights remaining: %s.
message.dreamsdimensions.sleep.risk: Warning: you have no Awakener. Search for a Recovery Ruin and follow the Moss Echo.
message.dreamsdimensions.echo_moss.recov: The moss reveals a ruin %s, roughly %s blocks from here.
No Recovery Ruin was located in this area. Explore and try again.
tooltip.dreamsdimensions.cracked_awakene: Hold for 10 seconds to return to the Overworld.
Emergency return: causes Dream Hangover and locks the Necklace for three nights.
message.dreamsdimensions.kettle.needs_fi: Place the kettle on a lit campfire.
message.dreamsdimensions.kettle.invalid: Use water bottles, Toasted Vigil Herb or Plumite Shards. Collect the batch before restarting.
message.dreamsdimensions.kettle.status: Kettle: %s bottle(s), %s/400 ticks. Use an empty hand to collect completed infusions.
tooltip.dreamsdimensions.plume_lining: At a smithing table: lining in main hand, armor in offhand.
tooltip.dreamsdimensions.vigil_tether: Arm before crossing; one rescue within two minutes.
